notes.opencode: OpenCode Go is a flat subscription (https://opencode.ai/docs/go); no per-token rates are published. Operators may override per model under CodeyBox:AgentPricing.
notes.claude: Cache-hit (read) rate captured under cachedInputPerMillion. Cache-write rates (1.25x base for 5m, 2x for 1h) are not represented; cost framework treats CachedInputTokens as read-side discount.
notes.codex: gpt-5.5 short-context rate ($5/$30). codex-5.5 aliases the same rate for CLI JSON attribution. Long-context tier (above ~270k input tokens) is not represented.
notes.gemini: gemini-3-flash-preview is the default AgentClasses model. Pro preview models use short-context rates (<= 200k tokens); long-context tier (>200k) is not represented.
notes.cursor: Cursor uses a flat subscription and does not publish per-token rates; intentionally omitted from defaults.
notes.copilot: Copilot uses a flat subscription and does not publish per-token rates; intentionally omitted from defaults.
